subject: SURF-007
reason: DEF-011, confirmed by looking rather than by the accessibility tree alone. Every row in the design carries trailing Inspect and Remove controls, and the flagged row carries Read first…; the built board's rows carry no trailing controls at all. The build also truncates the column that exists to explain — 'The router has recorded no calls to it ove…' — where the design shows the whole reason. Two differences run the other way and are not defects: the build adds a staleness banner and an observed-window bar saying history covers only 6d, and it adds filter chips and a filter field. Both are the build being more honest than its design, which is this product's stated posture.
